I will also spread manure from our livestock because it makes the soil fertile and we have plenty of it. I will plant improved seed this season because it gives a better harvest than our traditional seed, but I will not buy pesticides or herbicides since they are too expensive for this small plot. My family will do all the work by hand and rely on the rains, as we have always done.
